speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for telling me about your left knee pain. To better understand your condition, could you describe the nature of the pain and any specific activities that worsen or improve it?

speaker: Patient
text: 24-year-old male. The patient reports increasing pain and swelling of the left knee over 2 months. Describes the pain as severe enough to awaken him from sleep on several occasions. States he tried taking ibuprofen with no relief. No family or personal history of significant illnesses.

speaker: Doctor
text: That pain waking you from sleep is concerning for inflammatory or crystal-related arthritis. Have you noticed any redness, warmth, or a visible lump on the knee, and did you experience any trauma or a "pop" when the pain started?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Severe pain and swelling in the left knee. I also have Pain intensifying over 2 months, Painful awakenings during night, No relief with ibuprofen.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Gout (acute gouty arthritis)

REQUEST TEST: Serum urate, Synovial fluid analysis (polarized microscopy)
REQUEST IMAGES: Knee_X-Ray
